answer: At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a cipher tag. The trellis cap is checked at intake and quill shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 33 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
